title: I've been making a little game about running an AI lab
author: axelgarciak
selftext:
You start in a garage in 2017 with $1.5M, two co-founders and one GPU rack.

The Transformer paper hasn't come out yet. The goal is to reach AGI before everyone else. Without ending the world, ideally.

I'm currently tuning the gameplay so that it is balanced. I think it is currently too easy but we'll see about that once the game is released.

I thought about adding mechanics for resets and model nerfing but that would make the game too complex. 😅

Stay tuned for updates! I'd love to have some beta testers!
